description: This PHP source file generates a web page interface for managing Ethernet LAN ports on a gateway device. It includes functions to retrieve device parameters, display Ethernet port status and details, and allows users to associate Ethernet port 2 with specific networks like XFINITY HOME or HOME SECURITY. The file also incorporates JavaScript for handling user interactions and AJAX calls for saving configuration changes.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines if port 4 XHS is enabled based on device configuration parameters.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Maps Ethernet port statuses to human-readable status labels, considering operational mode and WAN configuration.
